subject.title: feat(apple): session search, archived browsing, and sheet management actions

question: Should Android model switching make stored operator tokens admin-capable, reissue or upgrade them on reconnect, or stay disabled when only non-admin stored scopes are available?
rationale: The PR adds an admin-only session mutation path to Android UI, but stored bootstrap handoff tokens deliberately filter out `operator.admin`, so the correct fix depends on the intended mobile auth boundary.

options.title: Add an explicit stored-token upgrade path
options.body: Persist, reissue, or migrate Android operator tokens so approved native clients keep the admin scope needed for model switching, with reconnect coverage and security review.

options.title: Gate model switching on admin availability
options.body: Keep stored tokens least-privilege and hide or fail gracefully for model switching until a fresh admin-capable connection is available.

options.title: Move model changes out of admin scope
options.body: Change gateway authorization so this specific session model mutation is allowed under a narrower scope, accepting a broader gateway security discussion before the client PR lands.

recommendation.title: Add an explicit stored-token upgrade path
recommendation.body: Persist, reissue, or migrate Android operator tokens so approved native clients keep the admin scope needed for model switching, with reconnect coverage and security review.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current client PR and the adjacent gateway/session authorization stack that owns this product and security boundary.
